title: FastMCP – Turn Any Python Function into an AI Tool (Free, Open Source)
description:
FastMCP is a free Python framework that lets you turn any function into a tool AI models can call with just a decorator. It handles schema, validation, and documentation automatically. Connect assistants like Claude to your own databases or APIs. Install with pip, decorate, and run.
